name: NGFS public proxy initialization
summary: NGFSToken left its single-use proxy initializer public, letting the attacker appoint its own contract as both privileged proxy and library, credit itself an unbacked NGFS balance, and sell it against the NGFS/USDT pool.
notes: The single-use delegateCallReserves initializer and reserveMultiSync were in the deployed non-proxy code; the attacker claimed the initializer inside the exploit, which is attack-installed state, not a reset (rule 10).
The same attacker contract reused its library role about 280 blocks later to mint again and sell into the pair; that transaction is campaign and its USDT is in the loss.
